lines.say: Why did Mike Tyson disappear from Punch-Out? His contract ran out.
Mike Tyson's Punch-Out came out in 1987, based on Nintendo's arcade boxing games.
Nintendo of America's Minoru Arakawa saw Tyson fight, and signed him for the game.
You play Little Mac, a 17-year-old boxer who weighs just 107 pounds, against 14 opponents.
Type in zero zero seven, three seven three, five nine six three, to skip straight to Tyson.
lines.cap: Type in 007 373 5963, to skip straight to Tyson.

lines.say: When the license ended in 1990, Tyson was replaced by Mr. Dream.
Did you ever beat Tyson? Follow for more 8-Bit Backstory!
